# Basic smoke test to verify scripttest framework

# Test basic command execution
exec echo "Hello, World!"
stdout 'Hello, World!'

# Test environment variables
env TEST_VAR=test123
exec echo $TEST_VAR
stdout 'test123'

# Test file operations
exec echo "test content" > test.txt
exists test.txt
contains test.txt 'test content'

# Test working directory
exec pwd
stdout $WORK

# Test negation
! exec false
! exists nonexistent.txt

# Test stderr matching
exec sh -c 'echo "error message" >&2'
stderr 'error message'

# Test conditional execution
[!windows] exec ls
[!windows] stdout test.txt

# Create files with -- marker
exec cat sample.txt
stdout 'Sample file content'
exists sample.txt

-- sample.txt --
Sample file content
